nodes.description: Private mapping of token balances in ANT contract; written by _transfer, setFeeTotal and constructor.
Private nested mapping of owner/spender allowances in ANT contract; written by _approve.
Bot/blacklist recipient address checked in _transfer; set only by owner via setBlackListBot.
Address exempted from the max-transfer blacklist check; set only by owner via setBlackAddress.
Total token supply, initialised to 200e9*10^18 and mutable via setFeeTotal.
Maximum blacklist transfer amount compared against amount in _transfer.
Private owner address from Ownable; guards onlyOwner restricted functions.
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender(); used for minting, transfers, ownership and access control.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender() to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and decrements allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Internal transfer implementing balance updates and blacklist/max-transfer validation.
Private allowance setter with zero-address checks.
Owner-only setter for _tBotAddress.
Owner-only setter for _tBlackAddress.
Owner-only function that increases _tTotal and mints new balance to the caller.
Owner-only setter recalibrating _maxBlack from a percent value.
View returning _balances[account].
View returning _tTotal.
View returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Owner-only ownership transfer updating _owner.
Owner-only ownership renouncement.
View returning the stored owner (returns address(0) in this code).
ANT constructor minting _tTotal to _msgSender().
Address library helper performing a low-level call with value.
Address library private helper performing a low-level call with value and bubbling reverts.
View returning _name string.
View returning _symbol string.
View returning _decimals.
Unbounded mint in setFeeTotal: _tTotal and caller balance grown by a caller-supplied amount with no cap.
Blacklist/max-transfer gate in _transfer that can block transfers to _tBotAddress based on owner-set state.
External low-level call transferring control and ETH to an arbitrary recipient/target before state checks.
Address parameter of _transfer identifying the source account.
Address parameter of _transfer identifying the destination account.
uint256 parameter of _transfer used for balance math and blacklist comparison.
Address parameter of setBlackListBot written into _tBotAddress.
Address parameter of setBlackAddress written into _tBlackAddress.
uint256 parameter of setMaxTxBlack scaled by 10**18 into _maxBlack.
Address parameter of transferOwnership written into _owner.

edges.reason: transfer forwards amount and caller data into _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer with sender, recipient and amount.
transferFrom decrements allowance through _approve.
approve writes allowance through _approve.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer compares recipient against owner-controlled _tBotAddress.
_transfer compares sender against owner-controlled _tBlackAddress.
_transfer enforces amount < _maxBlack for flagged recipients.
Blacklist/max-transfer enforcement is an owner-configurable restriction on token movement.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
setBlackListBot writes _tBotAddress.
setBlackAddress writes _tBlackAddress.
setFeeTotal grows _tTotal by an unbounded caller-supplied amount.
setFeeTotal mints new balance into _balances of the caller.
setFeeTotal implements an uncapped mint operation.
setMaxTxBlack writes _maxBlack.
balanceOf reads _balances.
totalSupply reads _tTotal.
allowance reads _allowances.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership affects the privileged _owner state variable.
owner reads _owner.
constructor mints _tTotal into _balances of _msgSender().
constructor assigns the initial supply to the caller address.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom spends _msgSender() allowance, making caller identity security relevant.
setFeeTotal mints directly to _msgSender() and must be owner-gated.
setBlackListBot is gated by onlyOwner against _msgSender().
setBlackAddress is gated by onlyOwner against _msgSender().
setMaxTxBlack is gated by onlyOwner against _msgSender().
onlyOwner modifier requires _msgSender() to equal _owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier requires _msgSender() to equal _owner before renounceOwnership executes.
transfer executes _transfer on its success path.
transferFrom executes _transfer before allowance bookkeeping.
approve calls _approve.
The max-blacklist branch conditionally reverts transfers depending on _maxBlack.
sendValue performs a low-level call{value} to an arbitrary recipient, transferring control.
_functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call{value} to an arbitrary target, transferring control.
The external call in sendValue hands execution control to the recipient, which may re-enter.
sender parameter feeds _transfer balance and blacklist logic.
recipient parameter feeds _transfer balance and blacklist logic.
amount parameter feeds _transfer arithmetic and max-transfer comparison.
blackListAddress parameter is stored into _tBotAddress.
blackAddress parameter is stored into _tBlackAddress.
maxTxBlackPercent parameter is scaled and stored into _maxBlack.
newOwner parameter is written into the privileged _owner state.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists to feed the core _transfer logic and should collapse into it.
The recipient parameter only exists to feed the core _transfer logic and should collapse into it.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the core _transfer arithmetic and should collapse into it.
blackListAddress is the sole input of the core setBlackListBot function.
blackAddress is the sole input of the core setBlackAddress function.
maxTxBlackPercent is the sole input of the core setMaxTxBlack function.
newOwner is the sole input of the core transferOwnership function.
